claims: The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day mission around the Moon in 2026.
Reid Wiseman is the NASA Commander for Artemis II.
Victor Glover is the Pilot for Artemis II.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist for Artemis II.
Jeremy Hansen is the CSA Mission Specialist for Artemis II.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon since Apollo 17.
Reid Wiseman is a U.S. Navy pilot.
Reid Wiseman is a former chief of the astronaut office.
Artemis II is Reid Wiseman's second spaceflight.
Victor Glover is a U.S. Navy captain.
Victor Glover piloted the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Victor Glover will be the first Black astronaut to fly around the Moon.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch participated in the first all-woman spacewalk.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
Artemis II is Jeremy Hansen's first spaceflight.
Jeremy Hansen is Canada's first astronaut for a lunar mission.
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft systems before future lunar landing missions.
